title: 过年的礼物 · 分级读物 (HSK 1-3)
source_material: The Gift of the Magi by O. Henry (1905), retold and set in China: a poor young couple each secretly sell their one treasure to buy the other a Spring Festival gift.

outline.title: 很穷的两个人
outline.summary: Introduce a young married couple, Xiao Li and Xiao Ming, who live in a small room in a Chinese city. They love each other very much but have very little money. The New Year (Spring Festival) is almost here, and Xiao Li wants to buy her husband a good gift, but when she counts her money it is far too little. She sits and cries a little, then dries her face.

outline.title: 两样最爱的东西
outline.summary: Explain that although the couple are poor, they each have one thing they treasure most. Xiao Li has very long, beautiful hair that falls below her waist — everyone says it is the most beautiful hair. Xiao Ming has a good old watch that his father gave him; it keeps perfect time and he loves it very much. These are the two things they are most proud of.

outline.title: 小丽的主意
outline.summary: Xiao Li thinks hard about what to give Xiao Ming. His good watch has only an old, worn strap, and she has often wanted to buy him a fine new watch strap. In a shop she finds a beautiful strap, but it costs far more money than she has. She stands at the shop window a long time, then suddenly has an idea and hurries out into the street.

outline.title: 卖头发
outline.summary: Xiao Li goes to a shop that buys hair. She takes down her long hair; the shopkeeper says it is very beautiful and pays her for it. Now her hair is short, but she has enough money. Happy, she buys the beautiful watch strap for Xiao Ming and hurries home, a little afraid of what he will say when he sees her short hair.

outline.title: 小明回家
outline.summary: Xiao Ming comes home and stares at Xiao Li's short hair, not moving, his face strange. She tells him she sold her hair to buy him a New Year gift, and begs him not to be unhappy. He holds her and says it is fine. Then he takes out his own gift and opens it: a set of beautiful hair ornaments (flowers) she had long admired in a shop — meant for her long hair.

outline.title: 最好的礼物
outline.summary: Xiao Li smiles through tears and says her hair grows fast. Then she gives Xiao Ming her gift — the fine watch strap — and asks for his watch to put it on. Xiao Ming smiles and tells her he sold his watch to buy her the hair ornaments. Now the strap has no watch and the ornaments have no long hair — both gifts are useless. But they gave each other the thing they treasured most, and that is the best gift of all.
